A little goes a long way: 20 to 40 reads.en: A little goes a long way: 20 to 40 reads as colour negative.
A little goes a long way: 20 to 40 reads.fr: Un peu suffit : de 20 à 40, on reconnaît le négatif couleur.
A little goes a long way: 20 to 40 reads.de: Wenig reicht weit: 20 bis 40 wirkt wie Farbnegativfilm.
A little goes a long way: 20 to 40 reads.ja: 少しで十分です。20〜40 でカラーネガらしくなります。
A little goes a long way: 20 to 40 reads.vi: Một chút là đủ: từ 20 đến 40 đã ra chất phim âm bản màu.
A little goes a long way: 20 to 40 reads.zh-Hans: 少量即可：20 到 40 就有彩色负片的味道。

A red glow around bright highlights, as.en: A red glow around bright highlights, as light scattered back through a colour film’s base.
A red glow around bright highlights, as.fr: Un halo rouge autour des hautes lumières vives, comme la lumière renvoyée à travers le support d’un film couleur.
A red glow around bright highlights, as.de: Ein rotes Leuchten um helle Lichter, wie Licht, das durch den Träger eines Farbfilms zurückgestreut wird.
A red glow around bright highlights, as.ja: 明るいハイライトの周りに赤い光のにじみを加えます。カラーフィルムのベースで反射した光のようにです。
A red glow around bright highlights, as.vi: Quầng đỏ quanh vùng sáng chói, như ánh sáng phản ngược qua lớp nền của phim màu.
A red glow around bright highlights, as.zh-Hans: 在明亮高光周围加上一圈红色光晕，如同光线在彩色胶片片基中反射回来。

Adds colour grain beside the grey: the c.en: Adds colour grain beside the grey: the coarser dye clouds of a colour film.
Adds colour grain beside the grey: the c.fr: Ajoute un grain coloré à côté du grain gris : les nuages de colorants plus grossiers d’un film couleur.
Adds colour grain beside the grey: the c.de: Fügt der grauen Körnung eine Farbkörnung hinzu: die gröberen Farbstoffwolken eines Farbfilms.
Adds colour grain beside the grey: the c.ja: グレーの粒子に加えてカラーの粒子を加えます。カラーフィルムの粗い色素の粒です。
Adds colour grain beside the grey: the c.vi: Thêm hạt màu bên cạnh hạt xám: những đám thuốc nhuộm thô hơn của phim màu.
Adds colour grain beside the grey: the c.zh-Hans: 在灰色颗粒之外加入彩色颗粒：彩色胶片较粗的染料云。

Amount sets how much; each colour below.en: Amount sets how much; each colour below takes that much of it (100 is all). Aqua and cyan respond about a third as strongly.
Amount sets how much; each colour below.fr: Intensité règle la quantité ; chaque couleur ci-dessous en prend cette part (100, tout). Le turquoise et le cyan réagissent environ trois fois moins.
Amount sets how much; each colour below.de: Stärke legt fest, wie viel; jede Farbe darunter nimmt diesen Anteil davon (100 ist alles). Aquamarin und Cyan reagieren nur etwa ein Drittel so stark.
Amount sets how much; each colour below.ja: 適用量で強さを決め、下の各色はその割合だけ受けます（100 で全量）。アクアとシアンの効きは約 3 分の 1 です。
Amount sets how much; each colour below.vi: Cường độ đặt mức tổng; mỗi màu bên dưới nhận phần đó (100 là toàn bộ). Xanh ngọc và lục lam chỉ phản ứng khoảng một phần ba.
Amount sets how much; each colour below.zh-Hans: 强度决定整体多少；下方每种颜色按该比例取用（100 为全部）。浅绿色和青色的反应约为三分之一。

Diffusion softens contrast and lifts the.en: Diffusion softens contrast and lifts the shadows next to bright areas; Glow haloes lights and keeps the blacks.
Diffusion softens contrast and lifts the.fr: Diffusion adoucit le contraste et éclaircit les ombres près des zones claires ; Lueur auréole les lumières et garde les noirs.
Diffusion softens contrast and lifts the.de: Diffusion mildert den Kontrast und hellt die Tiefen neben hellen Flächen auf; Leuchten umgibt Lichter mit einem Schein und erhält das Schwarz.
Diffusion softens contrast and lifts the.ja: ディフュージョンはコントラストを和らげ、明るい部分の近くのシャドウを持ち上げます。グローは光源ににじみを加え、黒は保ちます。
Diffusion softens contrast and lifts the.vi: Khuếch tán làm dịu tương phản và nâng vùng tối cạnh vùng sáng; Phát sáng tạo quầng quanh nguồn sáng và giữ nguyên màu đen.
Diffusion softens contrast and lifts the.zh-Hans: 柔焦柔化对比度，并提亮明亮区域旁的阴影；辉光为光源加上光晕，同时保留黑色。

Diffusion veils the whole picture as a d.en: Diffusion veils the whole picture as a diffusion filter does; Glow spreads only the highlights.
Diffusion veils the whole picture as a d.fr: Diffusion voile toute l’image comme un filtre de diffusion ; Lueur ne diffuse que les hautes lumières.
Diffusion veils the whole picture as a d.de: Diffusion legt einen Schleier über das ganze Bild wie ein Diffusionsfilter; Leuchten breitet nur die Lichter aus.
Diffusion veils the whole picture as a d.ja: ディフュージョンはディフュージョンフィルターのように画像全体を柔らかく覆い、グローはハイライトだけをにじませます。
Diffusion veils the whole picture as a d.vi: Khuếch tán phủ một lớp mờ lên toàn ảnh như kính lọc khuếch tán; Phát sáng chỉ lan tỏa vùng sáng.
Diffusion veils the whole picture as a d.zh-Hans: 柔焦像柔焦滤镜一样为整张照片蒙上一层柔光；辉光只让高光向外扩散。

Film: in the midtones, as grain always w.en: Film: in the midtones, as grain always was. Even: the same everywhere. Scanned negative: strongest in the shadows, fading in the highlights.
Film: in the midtones, as grain always w.fr: Film : dans les tons moyens, comme le grain l’a toujours été. Uniforme : partout pareil. Négatif scanné : plus fort dans les ombres, s’estompant dans les hautes lumières.
Film: in the midtones, as grain always w.de: Film: in den Mitteltönen, wie die Körnung schon immer war. Gleichmäßig: überall gleich. Gescanntes Negativ: am stärksten in den Tiefen, in den Lichtern schwächer.
Film: in the midtones, as grain always w.ja: フィルム：これまでの粒子と同じく中間調に。均一：どこでも同じ。スキャンしたネガ：シャドウで最も強く、ハイライトでは弱まります。
Film: in the midtones, as grain always w.vi: Phim: ở tông trung, như hạt vẫn luôn thế. Đều: như nhau ở mọi nơi. Âm bản quét: mạnh nhất ở vùng tối, nhạt dần ở vùng sáng.
Film: in the midtones, as grain always w.zh-Hans: 胶片：集中在中间调，与以往的颗粒相同。均匀：处处一样。扫描负片：在阴影中最强，在高光中渐弱。

Finishing touches: a vignette, a colour.en: Finishing touches: a vignette, a colour wash, halation, bloom and film grain.
Finishing touches: a vignette, a colour.fr: Touches finales : vignetage, voile de couleur, halation, bloom et grain de film.
Finishing touches: a vignette, a colour.de: Letzter Schliff: Vignette, Farbschleier, Halation, Bloom und Filmkörnung.
Finishing touches: a vignette, a colour.ja: 仕上げ：周辺減光、カラーウォッシュ、ハレーション、ブルーム、フィルムの粒子。
Finishing touches: a vignette, a colour.vi: Bước hoàn thiện: làm tối góc, phủ màu, quầng sáng, bloom và hạt phim.
Finishing touches: a vignette, a colour.zh-Hans: 收尾效果：暗角、颜色涂染、光晕、柔光和胶片颗粒。

Foliage turned red-magenta and reds turn.en: Foliage turned red-magenta and reds turned yellow, as on infrared colour film.
Foliage turned red-magenta and reds turn.fr: Feuillage rouge magenta et rouges virant au jaune, comme sur un film couleur infrarouge.
Foliage turned red-magenta and reds turn.de: Laub wird rot-magenta und Rot wird gelb, wie auf Infrarot-Farbfilm.
Foliage turned red-magenta and reds turn.ja: 赤外線カラーフィルムのように、草木は赤みがかったマゼンタに、赤は黄色に変わります。
Foliage turned red-magenta and reds turn.vi: Tán lá chuyển đỏ tím, màu đỏ chuyển vàng, như trên phim màu hồng ngoại.
Foliage turned red-magenta and reds turn.zh-Hans: 如红外彩色胶片：植物变成红品色，红色变成黄色。

Greens turned purple, blues turned green.en: Greens turned purple, blues turned green and yellows turned pink.
Greens turned purple, blues turned green.fr: Les verts virent au violet, les bleus au vert et les jaunes au rose.
Greens turned purple, blues turned green.de: Grün wird violett, Blau wird grün und Gelb wird rosa.
Greens turned purple, blues turned green.ja: 緑は紫に、青は緑に、黄は桃色に変わります。
Greens turned purple, blues turned green.vi: Xanh lá chuyển tím, xanh dương chuyển xanh lá, vàng chuyển hồng.
Greens turned purple, blues turned green.zh-Hans: 绿色变紫，蓝色变绿，黄色变粉。

How bright, as shown, a part of the pict.en: How bright, as shown, a part of the picture must be before it glows.
How bright, as shown, a part of the pict.fr: La luminosité, telle qu’affichée, qu’une partie de l’image doit atteindre pour rayonner.
How bright, as shown, a part of the pict.de: Wie hell ein Bildteil in der Anzeige sein muss, bevor er leuchtet.
How bright, as shown, a part of the pict.ja: 画像のどこかが光り始めるのに必要な、表示上の明るさです。
How bright, as shown, a part of the pict.vi: Một vùng ảnh phải sáng đến đâu (như đang hiển thị) thì mới phát sáng.
How bright, as shown, a part of the pict.zh-Hans: 画面某处按显示亮度需要多亮才开始发光。

Lamps, neon and bright windows pick up a.en: Lamps, neon and bright windows pick up a warm fringe. It acts on light, so brighter highlights glow more.
Lamps, neon and bright windows pick up a.fr: Lampes, néons et fenêtres claires prennent une frange chaude. L’effet agit sur la lumière : plus une haute lumière est vive, plus elle rayonne.
Lamps, neon and bright windows pick up a.de: Lampen, Neon und helle Fenster bekommen einen warmen Saum. Es wirkt auf das Licht, daher leuchten hellere Lichter stärker.
Lamps, neon and bright windows pick up a.ja: ランプやネオン、明るい窓に暖かい縁取りが付きます。光に作用するので、明るいハイライトほど強く光ります。
Lamps, neon and bright windows pick up a.vi: Đèn, neon và ô cửa sáng có viền ấm. Hiệu ứng tác động lên ánh sáng nên vùng càng sáng càng phát sáng mạnh.
Lamps, neon and bright windows pick up a.zh-Hans: 灯光、霓虹和明亮的窗户会带上一圈暖色边缘。它作用于光线，高光越亮，光晕越强。

Leaves brightness alone; with Amount at.en: Leaves brightness alone; with Amount at 0 it is colour grain only.
Leaves brightness alone; with Amount at.fr: Ne touche pas à la luminosité ; avec Intensité à 0, il n’y a que le grain coloré.
Leaves brightness alone; with Amount at.de: Lässt die Helligkeit unverändert; bei Stärke 0 gibt es nur Farbkörnung.
Leaves brightness alone; with Amount at.ja: 明るさは変えません。適用量が 0 ならカラーの粒子だけになります。
Leaves brightness alone; with Amount at.vi: Không đổi độ sáng; khi Cường độ bằng 0 thì chỉ còn hạt màu.
Leaves brightness alone; with Amount at.zh-Hans: 不改变亮度；强度为 0 时只有彩色颗粒。

Lower it to let more of the picture glow.en: Lower it to let more of the picture glow.
Lower it to let more of the picture glow.fr: Baissez-le pour qu’une plus grande partie de l’image rayonne.
Lower it to let more of the picture glow.de: Senken Sie ihn, damit mehr vom Bild leuchtet.
Lower it to let more of the picture glow.ja: 下げると、画像のより多くの部分が光ります。
Lower it to let more of the picture glow.vi: Hạ xuống để nhiều phần ảnh phát sáng hơn.
Lower it to let more of the picture glow.zh-Hans: 调低可让画面更多部分发光。

Makes colour denser, as slide film’s dye.en: Makes colour denser, as slide film’s dyes do: saturated colours darken (or lighten, left) while their hue stays, and greys are untouched.
Makes colour denser, as slide film’s dye.fr: Rend la couleur plus dense, comme les colorants d’un film inversible : les couleurs saturées foncent (ou s’éclaircissent, à gauche) en gardant leur teinte, et les gris ne bougent pas.
Makes colour denser, as slide film’s dye.de: Macht Farbe dichter, wie die Farbstoffe eines Diafilms: Gesättigte Farben werden dunkler (oder nach links heller), ihr Farbton bleibt, und Grautöne bleiben unberührt.
Makes colour denser, as slide film’s dye.ja: スライドフィルムの色素のように色の密度を上げます。彩度の高い色は色相を保ったまま暗く（左では明るく）なり、グレーは変わりません。
Makes colour denser, as slide film’s dye.vi: Làm màu đặc hơn, như thuốc nhuộm của phim dương bản: màu bão hòa tối đi (hoặc sáng lên khi kéo trái) mà giữ nguyên sắc màu, còn màu xám không đổi.
Makes colour denser, as slide film’s dye.zh-Hans: 像反转片的染料那样让颜色更浓：饱和的颜色变暗（向左则变亮）而色相不变，灰色不受影响。

Most at home in night scenes under tungs.en: Most at home in night scenes under tungsten and neon.
Most at home in night scenes under tungs.fr: Idéal pour les scènes de nuit sous lumière tungstène et néons.
Most at home in night scenes under tungs.de: Am besten in Nachtszenen unter Glühlampen- und Neonlicht.
Most at home in night scenes under tungs.ja: タングステン光やネオンの夜景で最も映えます。
Most at home in night scenes under tungs.vi: Hợp nhất với cảnh đêm dưới đèn sợi đốt và neon.
Most at home in night scenes under tungs.zh-Hans: 最适合钨丝灯和霓虹下的夜景。

Pair it with a little Saturation: colour.en: Pair it with a little Saturation: colour richer and deeper, not just louder.
Pair it with a little Saturation: colour.fr: Associez-le à un peu de Saturation : une couleur plus riche et plus profonde, pas seulement plus criarde.
Pair it with a little Saturation: colour.de: Kombinieren Sie sie mit etwas Sättigung: Farbe wird satter und tiefer, nicht nur lauter.
Pair it with a little Saturation: colour.ja: 彩度を少し足すと、ただ派手なだけでなく、深みのある豊かな色になります。
Pair it with a little Saturation: colour.vi: Kết hợp với chút Độ bão hòa: màu giàu và sâu hơn, không chỉ rực hơn.
Pair it with a little Saturation: colour.zh-Hans: 搭配少许饱和度：颜色更浓郁深沉，而不只是更艳。

The targeted tool moves the H, S and L t.en: The targeted tool moves the H, S and L tabs, not Density
The targeted tool moves the H, S and L t.fr: L'outil ciblé agit sur les onglets T, S et L, pas sur Densité
The targeted tool moves the H, S and L t.de: Das selektive Werkzeug bewegt die Register H, S und L, nicht „Dichte“
The targeted tool moves the H, S and L t.ja: ターゲット補正ツールで動くのは H・S・L タブで、密度は動きません
The targeted tool moves the H, S and L t.vi: Công cụ mục tiêu điều chỉnh các thẻ H, S và L, không phải Mật độ
The targeted tool moves the H, S and L t.zh-Hans: 目标调整工具作用于 H、S、L 选项卡，而非“密度”

Warmth tints the glow: warm for a dreamy.en: Warmth tints the glow: warm for a dreamy haze, cool for a smoggy city.
Warmth tints the glow: warm for a dreamy.fr: Chaleur teinte la lueur : chaude pour un voile onirique, froide pour une ville dans le smog.
Warmth tints the glow: warm for a dreamy.de: Wärme tönt das Leuchten: warm für einen verträumten Dunst, kühl für eine smogverhangene Stadt.
Warmth tints the glow: warm for a dreamy.ja: 暖かさで光の色を変えます。暖かくすれば夢のような霞に、冷たくすればスモッグの街に。
Warmth tints the glow: warm for a dreamy.vi: Độ ấm nhuộm màu quầng sáng: ấm cho làn sương mơ màng, lạnh cho thành phố khói bụi.
Warmth tints the glow: warm for a dreamy.zh-Hans: 暖度为光晕着色：暖调营造梦幻薄雾，冷调营造雾霾都市。

Where in the tones the grain is stronges.en: Where in the tones the grain is strongest.
Where in the tones the grain is stronges.fr: Les tons où le grain est le plus marqué.
Where in the tones the grain is stronges.de: In welchen Tönen die Körnung am stärksten ist.
Where in the tones the grain is stronges.ja: どの明るさで粒子が最も強く出るか。
Where in the tones the grain is stronges.vi: Hạt rõ nhất ở vùng tông nào.
Where in the tones the grain is stronges.zh-Hans: 颗粒在哪个影调范围最强。
